text.p: Advanced Financial Inc, a residential mortgage banking company, said Tuesday that Norman Peterson has resigned as chairman.
It added that Peterson is resigning as an officer and director of Advanced Financial Inc and AFI Mortgage Corp subsidiary to pursue other interests.

Bill Moffatt, who in April was named president of AFI Mortgage and was later elected a director of the company, will serve as chairman until the board officially elects a replacement for Peterson, the company said.
In a statement, Peterson said the pending acquisition of a privately based mortgage banking company should increase Advanced's loan origination to an estimated $25 million a month.
The name of the mortgage banking company to be acquired was not disclosed.
He also said Moffatt brought to Advanced 12 years of mortgage banking experience.
"For these reasons, I believe that the company is poised for substantial growth in the future," Peterson said.
